complexity.notes: Correct but unidiomatic and fragile: the index()/pop() index-recovery logic is convoluted and each index() call is an O(n) scan. A one-pass hashmap (value -> index) achieves O(n) time far more cleanly, or sort (value, index) pairs to avoid the index-recovery hack entirely.
complexity.summary: Sorts a copy of the array and uses a two-pointer scan to find the pair summing to target, then recovers the original indices with nums.index(), with a pop-based workaround for duplicate values.
